name: webong/work-flow
description: Framework-agnostic workflow definitions, state evaluation, presentations, and actions.

suggest.illuminate/cache: Required to use the optional Laravel Redis WorkFlow store.
suggest.illuminate/database: Required to use the optional Laravel Eloquent WorkFlow store.
suggest.illuminate/support: Required to register the optional Laravel WorkFlow service provider.
suggest.spatie/eloquent-sortable: Required to persist and reorder optional Laravel Eloquent workflow definition steps.
suggest.temporal/sdk: Required to use the optional Temporal WorkFlow adapter.
